verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is a one-line pricing-page bullet, "Hand off and schedule tasks" (claude-docs-24, claude-docs-45). It does not say whether schedules can recur or explain how they are set up. Managed Agents are positioned for long-running, asynchronous work (claude-docs-2), but asynchronous execution is not the same as recurring scheduling. Missing for 10: documented recurring/cron-style scheduling, API- or CLI-level schedule management, details on triggers and frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
